assumptions_made: Used the Hugging Face fineweb dataset as specified in data_requirements
Synthesized binary sentiment labels based on presence of positive/negative words since the dataset lacks explicit labels
Applied simple whitespace tokenization as specified in preprocessing_steps
Used a basic bag-of-words approach with Laplace smoothing for both unigram and bigram models
Implemented the ablation study design comparing unigram vs unigram+bigram features
Set a maximum of 1000 rows to prevent excessive memory usage while maintaining statistical significance
Used a fixed test split ratio of 0.25 for consistent evaluation

results.hypothesis: Test whether bigram features improve sentiment classification accuracy over unigrams alone.
results.author: coder-agent
results.baseline: Unigram naive Bayes on the same split.
results.success_criteria: Adding bigrams improves accuracy by at least 0.02 on the held-out split.
results.notes: Unigram accuracy: 1.000, Bigram accuracy: 0.620, Improvement: -0.380. Bigram model does not meet success criteria.
